title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of General Theft Cases
source: Synthesized from BPR&D Property Offenses Investigation Manual and State Police SOPs

steps.title: FIR Registration & Crime Scene Inspection
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Section 303 (formerly IPC 379). Visit the crime scene immediately to document the point of entry/exit and the exact location from where the property was stolen. Prepare a rough spot map and panchnama.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR under BNS Section 303
Crime scene inspection memo / Panchnama
List of stolen property with descriptions/serial numbers
steps.condition_to_start: Complainant reports theft of movable property.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and initial scene inspection documented.
if_blocked: If the complainant cannot immediately provide serial numbers or bills of stolen items, register the FIR with available descriptions and add the specifics later via supplementary statement.

steps.title: CCTV Requisition & Route Mapping
steps.description: Identify and requisition footage from private CCTV cameras in the vicinity of the crime scene and suspected escape routes. Issue BNSS Section 94 notices to property owners.
required_evidence: CCTV video footage of the occurrence or suspects loitering
Section 63 BSA electronic admissibility certificates
steps.condition_to_start: Crime scene inspected and perimeter defined.
steps.condition_to_complete: CCTV footage procured and analyzed for suspect identification.
if_blocked: If DVR owners refuse to hand over footage, execute an immediate seizure under BNSS Section 106 to prevent overwriting.

steps.title: Forensic Evidence Collection (Latent Prints & Trace)
steps.description: Summon the FSL Mobile unit or fingerprint expert to lift latent fingerprints, footprints, or tool marks from points of entry, forced locks, or touched surfaces at the crime scene.
required_evidence: Lifted fingerprint chance prints
Photographs of tool marks or footprints
FSL Scene Examination Report
steps.condition_to_start: Crime scene is untouched and secured.
steps.condition_to_complete: Forensic evidence successfully lifted and forwarded for comparison.
if_blocked: If the FSL team is delayed, IO must carefully dust and lift visible prints using the standard police station investigation kit.

steps.title: Telecom Tower Dump & Suspect Mobile Tracking
steps.description: If the time of theft is narrow, issue Section 94 BNSS notices to telecom operators for a tower dump of the crime scene. Filter active numbers against local history-sheeters. If a mobile phone was stolen, place the IMEI on tracking.
required_evidence: Cell ID Tower dump logs
IMEI tracking activation report
Filtered suspect subscriber CAF details
steps.condition_to_start: Time window of theft established or stolen mobile IMEI available.
steps.condition_to_complete: Tower dump analyzed and stolen IMEI flagged on operator networks.
if_blocked: If the stolen phone is switched off, monitor the IMEI persistently via the CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) portal.

steps.title: Tracing Stolen Property Disposal (Pawn Shops & E-commerce)
steps.description: Circulate descriptions of stolen items (especially jewelry or electronics) to local pawn shops and jewelers. Issue Section 94 BNSS notices to e-commerce platforms (like OLX) if items are suspected to be listed for resale online.
required_evidence: Pawn shop pledge registers or CCTV
E-commerce listing details, seller KYC, and IP logs
Seizure memo of recovered stolen property
steps.condition_to_start: Stolen property uniquely identifiable (IMEI, serial numbers, hallmark).
steps.condition_to_complete: Stolen property located at disposal point and seller identity established.
if_blocked: If jewelers melted the stolen gold, seize the melting register and CCTV to establish the identity of the seller/thief.

steps.title: Arrest, Recovery & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Arrest the identified suspects under BNSS Section 35. Recover the stolen property based on the accused's disclosure statement under Section 23 BSA. Produce the accused in court, restore property to the victim via Section 503 BNSS, and file the final chargesheet.
required_evidence: Arrest and personal search memo
Disclosure statement leading to recovery (Section 23 BSA)
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193
steps.condition_to_start: Suspect identity established via CCTV, fingerprints, or property tracking.
steps.condition_to_complete: Accused charged and property restored via judicial order.
if_blocked: If property is not recovered, focus the chargesheet on circumstantial evidence (CCTV, telecom presence, and fingerprints).

dead_end_strategies.condition: No CCTV available, no fingerprints found, and stolen items lack serial numbers.
suggested_actions: Activate local informant networks to check known receivers of stolen goods (scrap dealers, chor bazaars).
Check recent release registers from the local Prisons Department for known burglars/thieves operating with the same Modus Operandi.
Profile the victim's domestic help, recent contractors, or delivery personnel for potential insider involvement.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Snatching Cases
source: Synthesized from BPR&D Street Crimes Manual and BNS Snatching Provisions

steps.title: FIR Registration & Victim Debriefing
steps.description: Register FIR immediately under BNS Section 304 (Snatching). Interview the victim to obtain physical descriptions of the snatchers, the getaway vehicle (make, model, color, partial license plate), and the exact direction of flight. Broadcast an immediate wireless alert.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR under BNS Section 304
Victim's statement with suspect and vehicle descriptions
Wireless control room broadcast log
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports forcible grabbing of chain, bag, or mobile on the street.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and immediate flash alert transmitted to all patrolling units.
if_blocked: If the victim is injured from a fall during the snatching, ensure immediate Medico-Legal Case (MLC) examination and add BNS Section 117 (Grievous Hurt) if applicable.

steps.title: CCTV Trajectory Mapping & RTO Vehicle Verification
steps.description: Requisition CCTV footage from private establishments and traffic junctions along the escape route. If a license plate is visible, verify the ownership details through the RTO VAHAN database. Snatchers frequently use stolen bikes, so cross-check the plate against recent vehicle theft FIRs.
required_evidence: CCTV footage tracking the getaway vehicle
RTO VAHAN vehicle ownership extract
Section 63 BSA electronic admissibility certificates
steps.condition_to_start: Escape route or partial license plate identified.
steps.condition_to_complete: Vehicle identified and registered owner located or flagged as stolen.
if_blocked: If the license plate is fake or removed, identify the unique features of the bike (stickers, broken parts) and check municipal smart-city ANPR cameras across the city.

steps.title: Stolen Device Tracking & Telecom Analysis
steps.description: If a mobile phone was snatched, immediately issue Section 94 BNSS notices to telecom operators to track the IMEI. If the phone is kept on, obtain live cell site locations. If a chain/bag was snatched, pull a tower dump of the incident spot to identify continuously moving numbers mirroring the escape route.
required_evidence: IMEI tracking logs / CEIR portal alerts
Cell ID tower dump and CDR analysis
Suspect subscriber CAF details
steps.condition_to_start: Stolen mobile IMEI available or precise time/location of snatching known.
steps.condition_to_complete: Stolen device traced or suspect mobile numbers identified from tower dumps.
if_blocked: If the stolen phone is switched off immediately, monitor the victim's linked UPI/bank accounts in case the snatchers attempt SIM bypass fraud.

steps.title: Tracing Stolen Jewelry (Pawn Shops & Goldsmiths)
steps.description: If a gold chain was snatched, immediately circulate the weight and design to local pawn shops, muthoot finance branches, and neighborhood goldsmiths under Section 94 BNSS to intercept attempts to pledge or melt the gold.
required_evidence: Pawn shop pledge registers or CCTV
Seizure memo of recovered gold or cash equivalents
Witness statements of the receiving jewelers
steps.condition_to_start: Gold chain or jewelry snatched.
steps.condition_to_complete: Receiver of stolen property identified and gold/cash seized.
if_blocked: If the gold is already melted, seize the melted bullion and the melting register, and arrest the jeweler under BNS Section 317 for receiving stolen property.

steps.title: Arrest, Test Identification Parade (TIP) & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Arrest the snatchers. Keep their faces covered upon arrest. Sponsor an application before the Magistrate to conduct a Test Identification Parade (TIP) under BNSS Section 54 so the victim can formally identify them. Recover the stolen property and file the chargesheet.
required_evidence: Arrest memos and disclosure statements
Magistrate's TIP (Test Identification Parade) proceedings report
Seizure memos of stolen property and the getaway vehicle
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193 specifying BNS 304
steps.condition_to_start: Suspects apprehended.
steps.condition_to_complete: TIP conducted, evidence secured, and chargesheet filed.
if_blocked: If the victim fails to identify the accused in TIP, rely on circumstantial recovery of the snatched property and CCTV facial matching to sustain the charge.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Snatchers wore full-face helmets, used a stolen bike with fake plates, and the snatched item was untraceable cash.
suggested_actions: Query the Prisons Department database for recently released offenders with a known Modus Operandi of high-speed snatching.
Expand the CCTV search radius to petrol pumps or toll plazas where the suspects might have removed their helmets or refueled before or after the crime.
Conduct systemic checks on known local gangs and their associates using historical gang mapping.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Burglary and House-breaking
source: Synthesized from BPR&D Investigation Manual on Property Offenses

steps.title: FIR Registration & Modus Operandi (MO) Documentation
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Sections 331-334 (Lurking house-trespass/house-breaking). Secure the premises. Document the specific Modus Operandi (e.g., lock broken, window grilled cut, roof entry) as burglary gangs have highly distinct signature methods.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR
Detailed spot map and crime scene Panchnama detailing point of entry
Inventory of stolen cash, jewelry, and valuables
steps.condition_to_start: Complainant reports break-in and theft from a residential or commercial building.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and MO accurately documented in the case diary.
if_blocked: If the owners are out of town, seal the premises with official police seals until they return to verify the stolen inventory.

steps.title: Forensic Fingerprint & Tool Mark Lifting
steps.description: Summon the FSL fingerprint bureau. House-breaking invariably involves physical contact with doors, cupboards, or safes. Lift chance prints, DNA swabs from discarded tools, and photograph jimmy/pry-bar marks for forensic comparison.
required_evidence: Lifted latent fingerprints and footprint casts
Seized burglary tools (crowbars, screwdrivers) left at scene
FSL Scene Examination Report
steps.condition_to_start: Crime scene secured.
steps.condition_to_complete: Fingerprints and tool marks lifted and sent to the state fingerprint bureau/NAFIS.
if_blocked: If the culprits wore gloves, check for biological evidence (sweat, blood from glass cuts) on broken entry points.

steps.title: CCTV Requisition & Night-Time Tower Dumps
steps.description: Procure CCTV footage from the targeted building, neighbor's properties, and street corners. Issue Section 94 BNSS notices to TSPs for a tower dump covering the specific night hours to isolate active mobile numbers in the residential area.
required_evidence: CCTV footage showing suspects or reconnaissance vehicles
Cell ID tower dumps and filtered suspect CDRs
Section 63 BSA electronic admissibility certificates
steps.condition_to_start: Timeframe of the burglary estimated.
steps.condition_to_complete: Video and telecom intelligence procured.
if_blocked: If the suspects deactivated the house CCTV DVR, check external municipal or neighbor cameras covering the perimeter.

steps.title: Prison & MO Database Query
steps.description: Cross-reference the specific Modus Operandi and lifted fingerprints with the Prisons Department and NCRB/NAFIS database to identify known burglar gangs currently out on bail or recently released.
required_evidence: Fingerprint match report from NAFIS / State Fingerprint Bureau
Inmate release registers or parole logs of known MO-matched offenders
steps.condition_to_start: Fingerprints lifted or distinct MO identified.
steps.condition_to_complete: Suspect matches identified from prison or criminal databases.
if_blocked: If database queries yield no hits, the gang may be from another state; circulate the MO and prints to neighboring state CIDs.

steps.title: Arrest, Stolen Property Recovery & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Raid the suspect hideouts. Arrest the burglars and receivers of stolen property. Seize the stolen goods, cash, and burglary implements. File the final chargesheet detailing the forensic and circumstantial links.
required_evidence: Arrest and personal search memos
Disclosure statements leading to recovery of stolen safes/valuables
FSL report matching lifted prints to arrested accused
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193
steps.condition_to_start: Suspects identified and located.
steps.condition_to_complete: Accused charged, property recovered, and court cognizance taken.
if_blocked: If stolen goods are untraceable, rely on FSL fingerprint matches and telecom presence at the scene to prove the house-breaking charge.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Burglary occurred in an isolated farmhouse with no CCTV, no cell tower coverage, and thieves wiped down the surfaces.
suggested_actions: Investigate inside contacts: domestic staff, recent painters/carpenters, or security guards who knew the layout and locations of safes.
Check local toll plazas or RTO ANPR cameras on the main access highways for unfamiliar vehicles moving during the night hours.
Alert pawn brokers and jewelers in adjoining districts regarding the specific descriptions of the stolen heirlooms.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Robbery
source: Synthesized from BPR&D Investigation Manual on Violent Property Crimes

steps.title: FIR Registration & Medical Evacuation
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Section 309 (Robbery). If the victim was injured during the extortion of property, immediately transport them to a hospital for a Medico-Legal Case (MLC) examination. Record the victim's statement detailing the threat, weapons used, and suspect descriptions.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR under BNS Section 309
Victim's statement under BNSS Section 180
Certified MLC report detailing physical injuries sustained
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports property stolen via fear of instant hurt or wrongful restraint.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered, victim treated, and statements recorded.
if_blocked: If the victim is in shock, wait for medical clearance to obtain a coherent description of the assailants.

steps.title: Crime Scene Forensics & CCTV Tracing
steps.description: Inspect the crime scene. Summon FSL to lift trace evidence (bloodstains, weapon markings, tire tracks). Issue Section 94 BNSS notices to secure CCTV footage of the robbery and the escape route of the suspects.
required_evidence: FSL Scene Examination Report
CCTV video footage with Section 63 BSA certificates
Seizure memos of trace evidence left at the spot
steps.condition_to_start: Crime scene secured.
steps.condition_to_complete: Forensic evidence lifted and CCTV procured.
if_blocked: If the robbery occurred in transit (e.g., highway), utilize toll plaza cameras and highway patrol ANPR systems under entity_id rto_parivahan.

steps.title: Telecom Tracking & Tower Dumps
steps.description: Issue notices to TSPs for a tower dump of the incident location. If the victim's mobile phone was taken, place the IMEI on live tracking. Analyze CDRs to find common movement patterns among suspected numbers.
required_evidence: Cell ID tower dump logs
IMEI tracking activation reports
Filtered suspect CDR analysis
steps.condition_to_start: Time and location of robbery established.
steps.condition_to_complete: Telecom tracking initiated and suspect numbers filtered.
if_blocked: If suspects use jammers or immediately switch off phones, rely on visual CCTV trajectory mapping.

steps.title: Arms Tracing (If Armed Robbery)
steps.description: If firearms or deadly weapons were used, coordinate with the Arms Licensing Authority and FSL ballistics division (if shots were fired) to trace the origin of the weapons.
required_evidence: Ballistic exhibits (cartridges/bullets) if fired
Statements detailing the specific type of weapon wielded
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports or scene indicates use of firearms/weapons.
steps.condition_to_complete: Weapon type identified and ballistic evidence processed.
if_blocked: If country-made illegal firearms were used, utilize informant networks to trace local illicit gunsmiths.

steps.title: Arrest, Recovery, TIP & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Arrest the suspects. Seize the stolen property and weapons used. Produce suspects with muffled faces before the Magistrate to conduct a Test Identification Parade (TIP). File the final chargesheet.
required_evidence: Arrest and recovery seizure memos
Magistrate's TIP proceedings report confirming victim identified the robbers
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193
steps.condition_to_start: Suspects located and apprehended.
steps.condition_to_complete: Accused charged, TIP successful, and stolen property recovered.
if_blocked: If TIP is refused by accused or fails, use CCTV facial matching and forensic links to the recovered stolen goods.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Highway robbery by unidentified gang with no CCTV, no cell tower overlap, and victim could not see faces due to darkness/masks.
suggested_actions: Coordinate with adjoining districts to identify similar highway robbery Modus Operandi (e.g., throwing eggs on windshields, placing spikes on roads).
Monitor local mechanics and scrap dealers for the victim's stolen vehicle or parts.
Check prison release logs for specialized highway robbery gangs (e.g., axle gangs).

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Dacoity Cases
source: Synthesized from BPR&D Organized Crime and Dacoity Investigation Manuals

steps.title: FIR Registration, Border Sealing & Medical Triage
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Section 310 (Dacoity - 5 or more persons). Immediately issue a flash alert to all neighboring districts and border checkpoints to set up barricades (Naka-bandi). Transport any injured victims to the hospital for MLCs.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR under BNS Section 310
Wireless transmission logs for border sealing
Certified MLC reports for injured victims
steps.condition_to_start: Report of robbery committed conjointly by five or more persons.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered, borders sealed, and victims treated.
if_blocked: If the gang escapes via a train or public transport, immediately alert GRP/RPF control rooms to intercept the train.

steps.title: Comprehensive Crime Scene Forensics
steps.description: Dacoity scenes are large and chaotic. Secure the perimeter. FSL must lift fingerprints, footprints, ballistic evidence, and DNA from items left behind (e.g., clothing, tools, masks). Requisition any local CCTV footage.
required_evidence: FSL exhaustive Scene Examination Report
Lifted latent prints, ballistic exhibits, and biological swabs
Crime scene photography and mapping
steps.condition_to_start: Crime scene secured.
steps.condition_to_complete: All physical and trace evidence scientifically packaged and forwarded.
if_blocked: If the scene is a moving train (Train Dacoity), halt the train at the nearest major station and secure the affected coaches for FSL inspection.

steps.title: Telecom Tracing & Transport Node Scrutiny
steps.description: Issue notices to TSPs for extensive tower dumps. Check CCTV and ANPR logs from toll plazas, railway stations, and bus stands along escape routes. Dacoit gangs often travel in large groups using stolen multi-utility vehicles.
required_evidence: Cell ID tower dumps
ANPR logs and toll plaza CCTV footage
Railway station/Transit CCTV
steps.condition_to_start: Escape routes hypothesized.
steps.condition_to_complete: Telecom and transit tracking data procured.
if_blocked: If telecom dumps are too massive, cross-reference numbers moving in sequence from the crime scene tower to highway towers.

steps.title: Inter-State Gang Profiling & Prison Intel
steps.description: Dacoity is usually committed by specialized inter-state gangs (e.g., Chaddi-Baniyan gang, Pardhi gang). Cross-reference the MO and forensic prints with the Prisons Department, NAFIS, and State Crime Branch databases.
required_evidence: Dossiers of known dacoity gangs matching the MO
NAFIS fingerprint matching reports
Prison release registers of organized gang members
steps.condition_to_start: MO documented and forensic prints lifted.
steps.condition_to_complete: Target gang identified from criminal records.
if_blocked: If the gang is a new splinter group, rely on informant networks and monitoring of traditional receivers of mass stolen gold/goods.

steps.title: Coordinated Raid, Recovery, TIP & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Execute heavily armed raids on the gang's hideout (often requiring inter-state coordination). Arrest the dacoits, seize the weapons and mass stolen property. Conduct TIP before a Magistrate and file the chargesheet under BNS Section 310.
required_evidence: Arrest and massive recovery seizure memos
Magistrate's TIP proceedings report
FSL ballistic and fingerprint matching reports
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193
steps.condition_to_start: Gang hideout located.
steps.condition_to_complete: Gang dismantled, evidence secured, and chargesheet filed.
if_blocked: If the gang opens fire during the raid, exercise the right of private defense and register additional Attempt to Murder/Arms Act cases.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Organized dacoity in a remote rural area, communication lines cut prior to attack, and gang vanished into forest terrain.
suggested_actions: Deploy tracker dogs (K9 units) immediately from the crime scene to trace the physical foot-trail into the forest.
Check local railway stations for sudden bulk ticket purchases or unauthorized train boardings in the hours following the incident.
Examine the pre-incident reconnaissance: gangs often send spotters disguised as hawkers or beggars days before; check local village CCTV or statements for unfamiliar visitors.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Motor Vehicle Theft
source: Synthesized from Anti-Auto Theft Squad (AATS) Guidelines and NCRB CCTNS SOPs

steps.title: FIR Registration & Immediate CCTNS / VAHAN Alert
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Section 303. Immediately upload the vehicle's Registration Number, Engine Number, and Chassis Number onto the NCRB CCTNS portal to flag it nationally as stolen. Verify ownership via RTO databases.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR and victim's statement
NCRB CCTNS Stolen Vehicle alert receipt
RTO VAHAN ownership extract
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports theft of a motor vehicle.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and national database flagged.
if_blocked: If the victim doesn't remember the engine/chassis number, pull it directly from the RTO or insurance company portal using the license plate.

steps.title: CCTV Requisition & Highway ANPR Tracking
steps.description: Procure CCTV footage from the parking location. Track the vehicle's movement through municipal smart-city cameras and highway toll plaza ANPR systems to determine the escape route.
required_evidence: CCTV footage of the theft and escape
Toll plaza ANPR logs showing the stolen vehicle
Section 63 BSA electronic admissibility certificates
steps.condition_to_start: Theft location and time identified.
steps.condition_to_complete: Vehicle's trajectory mapped via surveillance.
if_blocked: If thieves changed the license plate immediately, look for distinctive vehicle features (stickers, dents) in the CCTV feeds.

steps.title: Telecom Dumps & Scrap Dealer Checks
steps.description: Analyze cell tower dumps of the theft location. Simultaneously, raid known 'chop shops', scrap dealers, and illicit garages where stolen vehicles are dismantled for parts. Check e-commerce platforms if the vehicle is listed for resale with forged papers.
required_evidence: Cell ID tower dump analysis
Seizure memos of vehicle parts from scrap dealers (if dismantled)
E-commerce listing IP logs (if applicable)
steps.condition_to_start: Vehicle untraceable on ANPR or suspected to be dismantled.
steps.condition_to_complete: Suspect numbers identified or dismantled parts located.
if_blocked: If the vehicle is suspected to be smuggled across international borders (e.g., to Nepal), alert border check posts immediately.

steps.title: Recovery, Arrest & Superdari (Restoration)
steps.description: Arrest the auto-lifters and receivers. Seize the vehicle. If the chassis/engine numbers are tampered/erased, send the vehicle to FSL for chemical etching restoration. File chargesheet and assist the victim in getting the vehicle released via court Superdari u/s 503 BNSS.
required_evidence: Arrest and recovery seizure memos
FSL Chassis/Engine number restoration report (if tampered)
Court order u/s 503 BNSS releasing vehicle to the owner
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193
steps.condition_to_start: Vehicle or thieves located.
steps.condition_to_complete: Vehicle recovered, accused charged, and property returned to owner.
if_blocked: If the vehicle is never recovered, issue an Untraced Report so the victim can claim motor insurance.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Vehicle stolen using high-tech relay attacks (keyless entry hacking), GPS tracker disabled instantly, and ANPR evaded.
suggested_actions: Focus on the sale of specialized electronic key-cloning devices on underground forums and track the buyers.
Check parking lot access logs and visitor registers for spotters who may have placed physical GPS trackers on the car days before the theft.
Coordinate with the manufacturer's backend telematics servers to see the exact timestamp the onboard SIM/GPS was disconnected.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Cattle Theft and Smuggling
source: Synthesized from Rural Policing Manuals and Animal Preservation Act SOPs

steps.title: FIR Registration & Scene Inspection
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Section 303 (and relevant state Animal Preservation / Cow Slaughter Acts if applicable). Inspect the shed/farm. Look for tire tracks of heavy transport vehicles (trucks/pickups) used to load the cattle.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR
Spot panchnama and victim's statement
Photographs/Casts of heavy vehicle tire tracks at the scene
steps.condition_to_start: Farmer reports theft of livestock.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and physical scene documented.
if_blocked: If the theft occurred in deep fields, track the physical hoof prints to the nearest motorable road to identify the loading point.

steps.title: CCTV, Highway Toll Plazas & Transport Tracing
steps.description: Cattle thieves rely on mini-trucks or modified containers. Requisition CCTV from village exits, highway toll plazas, and border checkpoints to identify suspicious transport vehicles moving late at night. Verify plates via RTO.
required_evidence: CCTV/ANPR footage of suspected transport vehicles
RTO VAHAN ownership details of the suspected truck
Section 63 BSA electronic admissibility certificates
steps.condition_to_start: Loading point or escape route estimated.
steps.condition_to_complete: Transport vehicle identified.
if_blocked: If vehicles use fake plates, issue alerts to highway patrols to intercept any trucks smelling of livestock or leaking animal waste.

steps.title: Check Illegal Slaughterhouses & Cattle Markets
steps.description: Raid known illegal slaughterhouses, meat processing units, and weekly cattle markets (Pashu Mandis). Coordinate with the Municipal Corporation health department to inspect municipal slaughterhouse registries.
required_evidence: Inspection reports from cattle markets
Municipal slaughterhouse entry logs
Seizure memo of stolen cattle (if found alive)
steps.condition_to_start: Escape vehicle traced or regular disposal points known.
steps.condition_to_complete: Stolen cattle recovered or disposal point identified.
if_blocked: If the cattle are already slaughtered, seize the hides and remains to perform DNA matching with the mother/offspring left at the victim's farm.

steps.title: Arrest, Veterinary Verification & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Arrest the thieves and butchers. Seize the transport vehicle. Requisition a Government Veterinary Doctor to verify the health, breed, and tagging (ear tags) of the recovered live cattle. Hand over cattle to the owner via court order and file chargesheet.
required_evidence: Arrest and vehicle seizure memos
Veterinary Doctor's verification report
Court order u/s 503 BNSS for custody of livestock
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193
steps.condition_to_start: Suspects and cattle located.
steps.condition_to_complete: Accused charged and cattle safely restored.
if_blocked: If the court process is delayed, ensure live cattle are temporarily housed in a recognized Gaushala / Animal shelter to prevent starvation.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Cattle smuggled across state or international borders in disguised containers with no CCTV coverage.
suggested_actions: Conduct cell tower dumps of the remote farm location; cattle thieves often coordinate via mobile while loading.
Check records of the local Animal Husbandry department or veterinary checkpoints for forged health transit certificates used by the smugglers.
Deploy informants in border smuggling syndicates to identify the specific transport handlers.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Forgery and Fake Documents
source: Synthesized from EOW (Economic Offences Wing) Manuals and BNS Forgery provisions

steps.title: FIR Registration & Seizure of Questioned Document
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Sections 336/338 (Forgery). The paramount step is to immediately seize the original questioned document (fake degree, forged cheque, manipulated agreement) in its physical form. A photocopy has extremely limited forensic value.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR under BNS Section 336/338
Seizure memo of the original questioned document
Complainant's detailed statement identifying the forged elements
steps.condition_to_start: Victim or authority reports a fabricated or altered document used to deceive.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and original disputed document securely seized.
if_blocked: If the accused refuses to produce the original document, obtain a search warrant u/s 96 BNSS to raid their premises and seize it.

steps.title: Verification from Issuing Authority
steps.description: Issue Section 94 BNSS notices to the purported issuing authority to verify authenticity. If it's a government certificate, check DigiLocker/MeitY records or Municipal/University archives. If financial, verify with the issuing bank.
required_evidence: Written verification report from the issuing authority declaring the document fake
Certified copies of the genuine baseline records (if any exist)
Verification from DigiLocker / issuer digital databases
steps.condition_to_start: Original disputed document seized.
steps.condition_to_complete: Official confirmation received that the document is forged.
if_blocked: If the issuing authority is a defunct private company, check their MCA21 filings to find the former directors for verification.

steps.title: Collection of Specimen Signatures & Handwriting
steps.description: Obtain permission from the Magistrate under BNSS Section 349 to collect specimen signatures, handwriting, and seal impressions of the accused in open court. Also, collect admitted genuine handwriting (e.g., from old bank forms or employment records) for robust comparison.
required_evidence: Magistrate's order u/s 349 BNSS directing accused to provide samples
Specimen signature/handwriting sheets taken in the presence of Magistrate/IO
Admitted genuine handwriting samples obtained via Section 94 BNSS
steps.condition_to_start: Suspect identified and document confirmed as fake.
steps.condition_to_complete: Specimen and admitted handwriting samples legally secured.
if_blocked: If the accused absconds to avoid giving specimens, rely entirely on their admitted genuine handwriting from known bank/government records.

steps.title: FSL Questioned Document Examination
steps.description: Forward the original questioned document along with the specimen/admitted handwriting and seals to the FSL Questioned Document (QD) division. Request analysis on handwriting matching, ink aging, paper alterations, and stamp forgery.
required_evidence: Forwarding letter with specific QD questionnaire
Certified FSL Questioned Document Expert Report admissible u/s 329 BNSS
steps.condition_to_start: Disputed documents and reference samples collected.
steps.condition_to_complete: FSL scientific report conclusively matching the forgery to the accused received.
if_blocked: If ink analysis is inconclusive, focus the prosecution on the behavioral usage of the document (who benefited financially from submitting it).

steps.title: Arrest, Raid of Forgery Setup & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Arrest the accused. Raid their premises to seize the forgery apparatus (printers, fake rubber stamps, blank certificates). File the chargesheet incorporating the FSL report and issuing authority's denial.
required_evidence: Arrest memo and search memo
Seizure memo of fake rubber stamps, printers, and blank paper stock
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193 specifying BNS 336/338
steps.condition_to_start: FSL report or overwhelming documentary evidence proves forgery by accused.
steps.condition_to_complete: Accused charged and manufacturing setup dismantled.
if_blocked: If the forgery was purely digital (PDF manipulation), seize the computers and request FSL digital forensics for original file metadata/creation logs.

dead_end_strategies.condition: The original forged document was destroyed by the accused, and only a WhatsApp photo of it exists.
suggested_actions: Charge the accused with Destruction of Evidence (BNS 238) alongside the forgery/cheating charges.
Extract the metadata of the WhatsApp image or PDF to show it was created or edited using Photoshop on the accused's device.
Focus on the financial/benefit trail: prove that the accused obtained an unlawful advantage (e.g., a job or a loan) by leveraging the contents of the document, invoking Cheating (BNS 318).

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Cheating and Criminal Breach of Trust (CBT)
source: Synthesized from EOW Investigation Manuals for White Collar Crimes

steps.title: FIR Registration & Contract/Inducement Analysis
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Section 318 (Cheating) or Section 316 (CBT). Collect all foundational documents: contracts, MOUs, email trails, and WhatsApp chats that show initial fraudulent inducement or the formal entrusting of property.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR under BNS 316/318
Copies of contracts, MOUs, or employment agreements
Emails and chats showing false promises or acknowledgment of entrusted goods
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports being duped into parting with money/property, or an entrusted agent misappropriates assets.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and documentary foundation of the business/trust relationship secured.
if_blocked: If the agreement was purely verbal, secure statements of independent witnesses who were present during the transaction.

steps.title: Financial Tracing, Bank Ledger Audit & Freezing
steps.description: Issue Section 94 BNSS notices to banks to obtain certified ledgers showing the flow of funds from the victim to the accused. If funds are still present, issue Section 106 BNSS notices to freeze the accounts.
required_evidence: Certified bank statements showing money flow
Confirmation of debit freeze under BNSS Section 106
Account opening KYC of the accused's bank accounts
steps.condition_to_start: Financial transactions alleged in the complaint.
steps.condition_to_complete: Money trail mapped and available funds frozen.
if_blocked: If cash was handed over physically, secure ATM withdrawal slips, bank withdrawal CCTV, and witness statements verifying the cash handover.

steps.title: Corporate Verification & MCA21 Scrutiny
steps.description: If the cheating was done under the guise of a company or investment firm, query the MCA21 database. Download incorporation documents, verify the active/strike-off status, and map the Director Identification Numbers (DIN).
required_evidence: Certificate of Incorporation and MOA/AOA
DIN details and director KYC
Financial balance sheets filed with RoC
steps.condition_to_start: Accused operated through a corporate entity or firm.
steps.condition_to_complete: Corporate veil pierced and true controllers identified.
if_blocked: If the entity is unregistered, utilize local municipal trade licenses and GST registrations to find the proprietor.

steps.title: Search, Seizure of Books & Arrest
steps.description: Raid the corporate office or residence of the accused. Seize account books, hard drives, forged invoices, and misappropriated goods. Arrest the accused and establish criminal mens rea (intention to deceive from the beginning for cheating, or subsequent misappropriation for CBT).
required_evidence: Arrest and search memos
Seizure memo of account books, computers, and misappropriated inventory
Forensic imaging of accounting software (Tally/Busy)
steps.condition_to_start: Documentary and financial evidence establishes fraud.
steps.condition_to_complete: Accused arrested and physical/digital ledgers seized.
if_blocked: If the accused claims it is a purely civil breach of contract, IO must explicitly document evidence of fraudulent intent at the inception to sustain the criminal charge.

steps.title: Forensic Audit & Charge-Sheet Filing
steps.description: Engage a police forensic auditor if the fraud is massive. Compile the bank trails, MCA records, seized ledgers, and auditor's report into a final chargesheet. Assist victims in seeking restitution through court.
required_evidence: Police Forensic Auditor report (if applicable)
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193
Application for restitution of frozen funds u/s 503 BNSS
steps.condition_to_start: Investigation complete and financial data audited.
steps.condition_to_complete: Charge-sheet filed and accepted by Magistrate.
if_blocked: If the accused fled abroad with the funds, initiate ED involvement under PMLA and seek Interpol Red Notices via CBI.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Accused declares bankruptcy and claims the inability to return entrusted funds was due to genuine business failure, not criminal intent.
suggested_actions: Conduct a deep forensic audit of the bank accounts to show diversion of entrusted funds to personal assets, family members, or unrelated shell companies (proving misappropriation).
Check for fabricated invoices or inflated expenses in the seized account books, which proves active deception.
Interview junior accountants or disgruntled employees who can testify to explicit instructions given by the accused to cook the books.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Counterfeit Currency and Fake Goods
source: Synthesized from RBI Master Circulars on FICN (Fake Indian Currency Notes) and Copyright/Trademark Act SOPs

steps.title: FIR Registration & Immediate Seizure
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Sections 178-180 (for Currency) or Copyright/Trademark Act (for goods). Immediately seize the suspected counterfeit currency notes or fake branded goods under a detailed seizure memo.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR
Seizure memo detailing serial numbers of FICN or descriptions of fake goods
Initial complainant/bank nodal officer statement
steps.condition_to_start: Bank, brand representative, or citizen reports fake currency or counterfeit goods.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and fake items securely seized.
if_blocked: If fake currency is detected in an ATM, immediately secure the ATM EJ logs and CCTV to identify the depositor or cash-loading agency.

steps.title: Expert Verification (RBI / Brand Nodal Officer)
steps.description: For currency: Send the notes to the designated Bank Nodal Officer or FSL/Currency Note Press for statutory verification of fake security features. For goods: Requisition the authorized brand representative/IPR attorney to certify the products as counterfeit.
required_evidence: Bank/RBI Nodal Officer verification report (for FICN)
Brand Authorized Representative Certificate (for fake goods)
FSL report on paper/ink quality
steps.condition_to_start: Suspected fake items seized.
steps.condition_to_complete: Statutory or expert confirmation received that items are counterfeit.
if_blocked: If the brand has no Indian office, utilize FSL to compare the seized goods against legally purchased genuine samples.

steps.title: Tracing the Supply Chain (Couriers & E-commerce)
steps.description: Trace backward from the point of seizure. If bought online, issue notices to the e-commerce platform and courier companies to identify the seller's KYC, dispatch warehouse, and payment routing.
required_evidence: E-commerce seller KYC and IP logs
Courier consignment tracking and sender address
Payment gateway settlement bank accounts
steps.condition_to_start: Counterfeit nature confirmed and point of retail sale identified.
steps.condition_to_complete: Upstream supplier or manufacturing origin traced.
if_blocked: If FICN was pushed through hawala routes, coordinate with border intelligence and telecom analysis of the local handlers.

steps.title: Raid Manufacturing Unit & Seize Apparatus
steps.description: Raid the printing press, illegal mint, or counterfeit factory. Arrest the masterminds. Seize specialized printers, high-quality paper, counterfeit security threads, dyes, and stitched labels.
required_evidence: Arrest memos
Seizure memo of manufacturing apparatus (printers, screens, dyes)
Huge stockpiles of semi-finished counterfeit inventory
steps.condition_to_start: Manufacturing or wholesale hub located.
steps.condition_to_complete: Factory dismantled, accused arrested, and apparatus seized.
if_blocked: If the manufacturing unit is across international borders (e.g., FICN printed overseas), refer the case to NIA/CBI for terror-funding and cross-border investigation.

steps.title: FSL Synthesis & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Compile the FSL reports linking the seized printers/dyes to the counterfeit currency/goods. File the chargesheet under BNS (for currency) or Copyright/Trademark Act. Obtain orders for the destruction of the fake inventory.
required_evidence: Certified FSL report matching printing apparatus to fake notes/goods
Final Charge-Sheet
Magistrate order for supervised destruction of counterfeit materials
steps.condition_to_start: Investigation complete and forensic links established.
steps.condition_to_complete: Accused charged and inventory slated for legal destruction.
if_blocked: If the volume of fake goods is too massive to store in Malkhana, apply immediately to the Magistrate for pre-trial destruction after drawing representative samples.

dead_end_strategies.condition: Retailer claims they received the fake currency unknowingly from a customer and have no connection to the printing syndicate.
suggested_actions: Check the retailer's CCTV to identify the customer who passed the fake notes.
Examine the quantity: possession of a single fake note may be innocent, but possession of a bundle of sequential fake notes implies active trafficking intent.
Check local bank branch reports to see if similar notes were deposited in the same geographic area recently.

title: Standard Operating Procedure for Investigation of Land Grabbing and Real Estate Fraud
source: Synthesized from EOW Land Fraud Manuals and State Registration Act SOPs

steps.title: FIR Registration & Primary Document Collection
steps.description: Register FIR under BNS Sections 318/336 (Cheating and Forgery). Collect the complainant's original title deeds, the disputed fraudulent sale/power-of-attorney documents, and written narratives of the fraud.
required_evidence: Copy of FIR
Complainant's original property title deeds
Copies of the disputed/fraudulent registry documents
steps.condition_to_start: Victim reports illegal sale, double registration, or land grabbing of their property.
steps.condition_to_complete: FIR registered and primary claims documented.
if_blocked: If the victim is physically ousted from the property, immediately coordinate with the Executive Magistrate for Section 164 BNSS (formerly 145 CrPC) preventive proceedings to prevent violence.

steps.title: Sub-Registrar & Revenue Record Verification
steps.description: Issue Section 94 BNSS notices to the Sub-Registrar Office. Procure certified copies of the fraudulent deeds, the Encumbrance Certificate (EC), and crucially, the Section 32-A biometric records (photos/thumbprints of the buyer, seller, and witnesses taken at the time of registry).
required_evidence: Certified sale deed and Encumbrance Certificate
Section 32-A biometric photographs and thumbprints from the Sub-Registrar
Mutation records from the local Tahsildar/Revenue office
steps.condition_to_start: Disputed property and registration details identified.
steps.condition_to_complete: Official registry records and biometric identities of the perpetrators procured.
if_blocked: If the local registrar claims the physical volume book is lost, escalate to the District Registrar (IGR) to pull archival backups or digital scans.

steps.title: Tracing the Financial Consideration (Money Trail)
steps.description: Real estate fraud requires a money trail. Issue notices to the banks mentioned in the fraudulent sale deed (DDs/Cheques/RTGS) to see who actually encashed the sale consideration. Freeze the recipient accounts under BNSS Section 106.
required_evidence: Bank statements of the buyer and fraudulent seller
Cheque/DD encashment CCTV and KYC details
Confirmation of account freeze under BNSS Section 106
steps.condition_to_start: Payment details identified from the fraudulent sale deed.
steps.condition_to_complete: Financial beneficiaries identified and funds frozen.
if_blocked: If the deed claims the entire transaction was in cash, document this as a massive red flag for fraud/money laundering and verify the buyer's financial capacity.

steps.title: FSL Document & Biometric Examination
steps.description: Obtain specimen signatures and thumbprints of the genuine owner and the arrested impostors. Forward these to FSL to compare against the signatures and Section 32-A thumb impressions on the fraudulent sale deed.
required_evidence: Specimen signatures/thumbprints obtained via court order
FSL Handwriting Expert report matching impostor signatures
FSL Fingerprint Bureau report confirming thumbprint mismatch with genuine owner
steps.condition_to_start: Section 32-A records and suspect specimens collected.
steps.condition_to_complete: Scientific proof of forgery established by FSL.
if_blocked: If FSL handwriting analysis is delayed, use the biometric photograph from Section 32-A to visually prove impersonation.

steps.title: Arrest, Interrogation of Witnesses & Charge-Sheet
steps.description: Arrest the impostors, the fraudulent buyer, and the attesting witnesses (who falsely identified the impostor). File the chargesheet incorporating FSL reports and Sub-Registrar records. Advise the victim to approach the civil court for formal cancellation of the deed based on the police charge-sheet.
required_evidence: Arrest memos of impostors, buyers, and attesting witnesses
Final Charge-Sheet under BNSS Section 193
Formal communication to Sub-Registrar placing a red-flag/alert on the property to prevent further sales
steps.condition_to_start: Forgery and financial trail proven.
steps.condition_to_complete: Syndicate charged and property flagged to prevent further alienation.
if_blocked: If the attesting witnesses claim they were also duped by the impostor, prove their complicity through telecom CDRs showing regular contact with the land mafia.

dead_end_strategies.condition: The fraud involves a property that has been re-sold multiple times to innocent third-party buyers after the initial forged sale.
suggested_actions: Focus the criminal investigation strictly on the first layer of forgery (the impostor and first buyer).
Trace the flow of funds through the subsequent sales to see if the 'innocent' buyers are actually shell entities controlled by the same land mafia.
Alert the Municipal Corporation under entity_id municipal_corporation to halt any pending mutation (name change) requests for the disputed property until the court decides.
